caption: The image shows a rectangular textile fragment with a dark blue background and light cream or white motifs woven into the fabric. The central portion of the textile features a large circular medallion with intricate floral and leaf patterns radiating symmetrically. Surrounding the central medallion, there are additional floral motifs and star-like shapes interspersed throughout the blue field. On the lower border, there are repeated shield-like shapes with eagles nearby, and above these are more stylized star patterns and flowers. Along the right edge, there are architectural elements resembling buildings with spires and horizontal lines, as well as birds in dynamic poses. In the bottom right corner, there is a rectangular cartouche containing the text "JANE WRIGHT OCT. 14 1824" in block capitals, with the letters and numbers formed by the same light cream or white color as the other motifs. The textile appears to be bordered by narrow plain bands, and the edges of the fabric are slightly irregular.
title: Woven Bed Cover
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
